name: gastrointestinal ulceration, recurrent, with dysfunctional platelets
description: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by recurrent gastrointestinal mucosal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, chronic anemia, iron deficiency, and abdominal pain. Disease features also include platelet dysfunction, and globally decreased eicosanoid synthesis.
